question: The greatest number, which divides 1477 and 671 to leave 0 and 6 respectively as remainders, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The greatest number dividing A and B with remainders R₁ and R₂ is the HCF of (A − R₁) and (B − R₂).

Required number = HCF of (1477 − 0) and (671 − 6)

Required number = HCF of 1477 and 665

Since 665 ends in 5, its factors are 5, 7, and 19. Checking the options, 7 divides both 1477 and 665 perfectly.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers to be divided = 1477 and 671

Remainders left = 0 and 6 respectively

**Formula Used:**

Required greatest number = HCF[(N₁ − R₁), (N₂ − R₂)]

**Calculations:**

⇒ First resulting number = 1477 − 0 = 1477

⇒ Second resulting number = 671 − 6 = 665

⇒ Prime factorization of 1477 = 7 × 211

⇒ Prime factorization of 665 = 5 × 133 = 5 × 7 × 19

⇒ The highest common factor (HCF) of 1477 and 665 is 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF for Equal Remainders

When the greatest number divides x, y, and z leaving the same remainder in each case, the number is the HCF of |x − y|, |y − z|, and |z − x|.

LCM for Specific Remainders

The smallest number which when divided by a, b, and c leaves remainders p, q, and r respectively (where a−p = b−q = c−r = k) is given by (LCM of a, b, c) − k.

Relation between HCF and LCM

For any two numbers A and B, the product of the numbers is strictly equal to the product of their HCF and LCM (A × B = HCF × LCM).
